messages:
jamie: Kicking off eu-west3 network bring-up now. Focus: transit routing, NAT egress, DNS delegation. Will run bootstrap then handoff to oncall.

jamie: Summary of intent: create TGW, attach prod VPCs, set up shared egress NAT and Cloud DNS zone, validate inter-region routing to us-east1 and eu-central-1.

sasha: Created transit gateway tgw-ew3-01 in infra-prod-eu project. ID: tgw-0a1b2c3d4e. Attached account routing policies = allow all internal prefixes for now.

lee: VPCs provisioned: prod-apps-ew3 (10.40.0.0/16), prod-data-ew3 (10.41.0.0/16). Subnets: public+private per AZ. I pushed route table entries but noticed rtb-private-1 missing 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-gw. Fixing.

maria: NAT design: single high-availability NAT gateway pair behind TGW egress ENIs. Using source NAT (SNAT) to mask internal prefixes. Created nat-gw-ew3-a and nat-gw-ew3-b.

dinesh: DNS: created private zone redwood.internal.eu-west3 in cloud-dns project and delegated NS to infra-dns. Added SOA and NS. Need registrar step to add glue if customers query from external.

lee: Terraform apply snippet used: 
```
module "tgw" {\n  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infrastructure//tgw"\n  name = "tgw-ew3-01"\n}\n```

jamie: Validation step 1: confirm TGW attachments show status AVAILABLE. Sasha, can you paste the quick AWS CLI check?

sasha: Ran: `aws ec2 describe-transit-gateway-attachments --transit-gateway-id tgw-0a1b2c3d4e --query "Attachments[*].{Id:TransitGatewayAttachmentId,State:State}"` -> returns states: AVAILABLE, AVAILABLE, PENDING (for shared-data account). I kicked the pending attach with accept-attachment on the target account.

ops-bot: deploy-runner: route-table-update applied by lee at 1789012401 :white_check_mark:

lee: After route updates, from a bastion in prod-apps-ew3: `curl -sS http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` -> succeeded. `curl -s https://dns.google/resolve?name=internal.service.redwood` -> NXDOMAIN expected until SRV records are added.

maria: Egress validation: outbound internet test from private host using nat-gw -> `curl -I https://example.com` returned 200 and TLS OK. Verified SNAT source shows 3.5.6.7 (nat elastic IP).

jamie: Inter-region routing check: traceroute from eu-west3 private instance to us-east1 internal endpoint shows via tgw-0a... and peering to tgw-us1, 6 hops, latency ~60ms. Good.

dinesh: DNS delegation check: `dig @8.8.8.8 ns redwood.internal.eu-west3` -> responding NS set to infra-dns-ew. I also pushed A records for internal load balancers: app1.prod -> 10.40.10.12, data-svc -> 10.41.5.7.

oncall: Quick note: cost alert - NAT elastic IPs and TGW data transfer might push monthly to +18% - set budget alarms.

jamie: Added a cost guardrail: apply route tagging and enforce intra-region traffic flows to avoid cross-zone egress. Will create cost-sensitivity tag on TGW: cost:high.

sasha: Security check: verified TGW route table does not contain 0.0.0.0/0 entries; only advertised internal prefixes. Confirmed no direct IGW attachment.

lee: Testing failover: simulate AZ outage by draining nat-gw-ew3-a. Traffic shifted to nat-gw-ew3-b, flows restored in ~45s. Logs show ephemeral connection resets for ~30s.

maria: Note for handoff: ensure oncall has runbook entries: how to rotate NAT EIPs, how to remove a TGW attachment, how to rollback DNS delegation. Added links in runbook doc.

jamie: Handoff checklist (quick):
- TGW created + attachments AVAILABLE
- Route tables populated for all VPCs
- NAT gateways deployed, EIPs assigned and validated
- Private DNS zone created + NS delegation verified
- Inter-region peering routes validated
- Cost monitors + budget alarms configured
- Playbook added to runbook repo and cross-linked in pager duty

oncall: I grabbed the runbook and will own 24h post-break glass window. Items to confirm next 2 hours: 1) Egress bandwidth metrics, 2) TGW metrics for dropped packets, 3) DNS TTL propagation.

jamie: Final ops commands captured for handoff: 
- accept attachment: `aws ec2 accept-transit-gateway-vpc-attachment --transit-gateway-attachment-id tgw-attach-0abcd`
- delete route: `aws ec2 delete-route --route-table-id rtb-0fff --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0`
- rotate EIP: `aws ec2 associate-address --allocation-id eipalloc-0abc1234 --instance-id nat-instance`

sasha: Pushed tags: `env=prod,region=eu-west3,service=tgw` to all infra objects.

dinesh: I'll follow up with a short postmortem if we see cost/time regressions. For now handing over to @oncall. :handshake:

oncall: Acknowledged. Taking ownership for 24h. If anything spikes, escalate to infra-paging and tag jamie/sasha.

jamie: Thanks team. I'll leave the runbook link here: https://wiki.redwoodinfra/internal/runbooks/eu-west3-network-bringup (add comments if you see gaps). :rocket:

maria: Added two quick action items to wiki: set DNS TTL to 60s for first 24h, and add healthchecks for NAT throughput.

lee: Closing thread from my side after I push the final route audit CSV to the shared bucket.

jamie: Thread closed for now. Follow-up in morning sync if any residuals.
